note.id: Seluruh lab ini bisa dikerjakan langsung di browser: edit pipeline.py di bawah, lalu klik Jalankan tes. Python berjalan di komputer Anda (WebAssembly); tidak ada yang dikirim ke server. Hasilnya sama dengan menjalankan pytest di terminal.
note.en: You can do this whole lab right here in the browser: edit pipeline.py below, then click Run tests. Python runs on your own computer (WebAssembly); nothing is sent to a server. The result is the same as running pytest in a terminal.

note.id: Bagian A (mini Kafka) bisa dikerjakan di browser: edit minilog.py di bawah, lalu klik Jalankan tes. Bagian B dan C memerlukan broker Kafka dan PostgreSQL, jadi dijalankan di komputer Anda atau Codespaces.
note.en: Part A (the mini Kafka) can be done in the browser: edit minilog.py below, then click Run tests. Parts B and C need a Kafka broker and PostgreSQL, so run them on your computer or in Codespaces.

note.id: Bagian A (model watermark dalam Python murni) bisa dikerjakan di browser: edit windows.py di bawah, lalu klik Jalankan tes. Bagian B memerlukan Spark dan Java, jadi dijalankan di komputer Anda atau Codespaces.
note.en: Part A (the watermark model in plain Python) can be done in the browser: edit windows.py below, then click Run tests. Part B needs Spark and Java, so run it on your computer or in Codespaces.

note.id: Bagian B (fungsi FinOps dalam Python murni) bisa dikerjakan di browser: edit finops.py di bawah, lalu klik Jalankan tes. Bagian A memerlukan Terraform, jadi dijalankan di komputer Anda atau Codespaces.
note.en: Part B (the FinOps functions in plain Python) can be done in the browser: edit finops.py below, then click Run tests. Part A needs Terraform, so run it on your computer or in Codespaces.
